insights.one_liner: Tesla is the US maker of electric cars, batteries and solar products; its Dutch entities are recognised visa sponsors and its one open role here needs no Dutch.

culture.text: A huge employer (about 92,600 people on LinkedIn) where most staff work in operations, engineering, IT and sales, often with mechanical engineering or computer science backgrounds.
Tesla says it expects everyone to challenge and be challenged, takes a first-principles approach and designs, builds, sells and services its products in-house.
Its one open job here is an entry-level data, analytics and AI role in Amsterdam.

open.text: Three Dutch Tesla entities, including Tesla International B.V., are IND recognised sponsors, so it can sponsor a highly skilled migrant visa.
Its current job here does not require Dutch.
Tesla says it is committed to hiring talent from around the world for any discipline.

growth.text: Staff grew from 48,817 in 2018 to 140,473 in 2023.
Revenue was USD 94.8 billion in 2025, with net profit of USD 3.79 billion.
Q3 2026 deliveries beat forecasts and Reuters said the car business is back on a growth path, though Cybertruck sales fell sharply.

worth_knowing.text: Investors are uncertain about a possible merger between Tesla and SpaceX.
Tesla wants to limit speeding in its Full Self-Driving system to win approval in the EU.
